title: Sri Aurobindo's birth chart
metaDescription: Sri Aurobindo's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 22.7° Leo. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: The Sun stands at 22.7° Leo, in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules. Of everything the chart can be read for without a birth time, that is the loudest single fact in it.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: At noon on that date the Sun stood at 22.7° Leo, inside the third decan (20°–30°), whose traditional sub-ruler is Mars. The decan is the older, finer division — it is what the sign looks like once you stop rounding it to thirty degrees.

blocks.title: The personal registers
blocks.text: The personal planets sit Mercury at 15.6° Virgo, Venus at 1.0° Virgo, Mars at 27.6° Cancer. Mercury in a earth sign reads as thought with its feet on the ground; Venus in a earth sign reads as attraction that grows by reliability; Mars in a water sign reads as effort that surges when it matters.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: Nothing in the geometry sits closer than Mercury and Saturn: 0.1° from an exact trine. A trine is an open channel. The two cooperate without being asked, which is exactly why it is easy to spend and easy to take for granted. Behind it, Mars square Neptune at 1.4°, and the Sun square Pluto at 1.9° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. Every angle named here holds for the whole of that day at the birthplace, so an unknown hour cannot take it away.

blocks.title: What the angles build
blocks.text: Mercury, Saturn, Pluto close a triangle of trines. Three trines close into a circuit the tradition calls a grand trine — ease so complete it can idle unnoticed for years.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: Read against the old dignities, five placements stand out. The Sun in Leo at 22.7° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules; Mercury in Virgo at 15.6° is in exaltation — the tradition’s honoured-guest placement, working at its best; Venus in Virgo at 1.0° is in fall — the tradition’s uphill placement, strength earned rather than given; Mars in Cancer at 27.6° is in fall; Saturn in Capricorn at 15.6° is in domicile. Dignity is a statement about conditions, not about worth.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Of the 9 placements whose signs hold for the whole day: 4 in fire, 4 in earth, 1 in water by element, 4 fixed, 3 cardinal, 2 mutable by modality. No settled placement falls in air — an absence the tradition treats as information, not as a defect. Saturn and Neptune were retrograde — the optical reversal the tradition reads as review — energy turned over before it is turned out.

blocks.title: The Moon is genuinely open
blocks.text: The Moon crossed from Sagittarius into Capricorn during that day at the birthplace, travelling 14.6° between one midnight and the next. Which of the two it was depends entirely on the hour, and the hour is not recorded. Rather than pick the likelier half, the reading leaves the Moon open.
